title: Exportable opportunity activity and usable question-aware assisted browser
steps: Add durable compact opportunity identities and structured stage/change events, including direct CLI/database changes and retired records
Expand Insights with activity filters, stage/outcome breakdowns, candidate-recorded events and complete CSV/JSON analysis exports
Remove repeated full manual-page inspection and blocking screenshot capture from interactive browser input; measure processing/frame latency
Detect selected/unnamed/iframe/contenteditable fields and nearby question guidance; draft evidence-grounded answers asynchronously and insert only into a validated target
Prompt for reminder dates and download calendar files with inline errors
Verify persistence/export integrity, stale target rejection, truthful drafts and browser responsiveness; deploy only when active work is idle
